in_sanskrit.name: रामनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rāma-nātha, derived from Rāma (Rama) and Nātha (God), meaning Rama's Abode, God of Wealth.

in_hindi.name: रामनाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rām-nātha, derived from Rāma (Rama, meaning Rama, God of Gods) and Nātha (Nātha, meaning Lord or God), meaning Paramātmā ke gṛha, Dhanapati, meaning God of Gods, or Rama's Abode.

in_tamil.name: ராமநாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rām-aṉ-nād, derived from Rāma (Rama, meaning Rama, God of Gods) and Nād (Nād, meaning Abode), meaning Rāmaṉ illōkkal, Valuvaṉ, meaning Rama's Abode or Rama's Palace.

in_telugu.name: రామనాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rām-a-nātha, derived from Rāma (Rama, meaning Rama, God of Gods) and Nātha (Nātha, meaning Lord or God), meaning Rāma-yya-hādōd, Daśapati, meaning God of Gods, or Rama's Abode.

in_marathi.name: Ramnath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rama + Natha (God of Shiva)

in_bengali.name: Ramnath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's Name
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramnath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rama + Natha (God of Shiva)
